request: Gateway28 live runtime default sanitize regression for other five destinations

bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
name="$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -E '^webhook-gateway-api(-[0-9]+)?$' | head -n 1)"
test -n "$name"
docker exec "$name" node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const c=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("/app/config/webhooks.json","utf8"));const d=Array.isArray(c)?c:(c.destinations||c.webhooks);if(!Array.isArray(d)||d.length!==6)process.exit(33);const selected=d.filter(v=>v.id==="server-core-bounded-host");if(selected.length!==1||selected[0].internalDataPolicy!=="preserve")process.exit(34);if(d.filter(v=>v.id!=="server-core-bounded-host").some(v=>v.internalDataPolicy&&v.internalDataPolicy!=="sanitize"))process.exit(35);if(d.some(v=>v.id==="server-core-host-output"))process.exit(36);console.log("GATEWAY28_OTHER_FIVE_SANITIZE=PASS")'
printf 'GATEWAY28_SANITIZE_REGRESSION=PASS\n'
